response.sql: WITH status_avg AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), ref AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS overall_avg FROM compliancecase), qualifying AS (SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_modelconf, s.avg_modelconf - r.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall FROM status_avg s CROSS JOIN ref r WHERE s.avg_modelconf > r.overall_avg) SELECT brokrepstat, avg_modelconf, diff_above_overall, avg_modelconf / AVG(avg_modelconf) OVER () AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying

assumptions.assumption: 'Average' means the overall mean modelconf across all compliance cases (case-level, NULL modelconf ignored). A status qualifies if its own mean is strictly greater. If the overall mean is NULL, no rows are returned.
Cases with a NULL brokrepstat form their own group, shown with a NULL status.
The ratio divides each qualifying status's average by the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages, with each status weighted equally. Values are not rounded.
